cohort: Unbooked mothers who delivered at the University of Port Harcourt Teaching Hospital (UPTH), Nigeria from January 1, 2009 to December 31, 2013
finding: The study found a positive correlation between lack of proper antenatal care and adverse pregnancy outcomes in unbooked patients.
mod_finding: Emergency caesarean section was the mode of delivery in 58.7% of unbooked women.
